title: Collateral Examination Worksheet — Borrowing Base of a Certificate on Operating Lines of Credit
content:
The borrowing base of a borrowing base certificate on the Operating Lines of Credit is figured from the collateral values stated on the line's most recent certificate — the one with the latest as-of date — and the product's advance rates for each collateral class.

## Definition

The certificate's borrowing base is the total of six amounts:

1. the stated unpriced stored grain value multiplied by the product's advance rate on unpriced stored grain;
2. the stated contracted grain value multiplied by the product's advance rate on contracted grain;
3. the stated market livestock value multiplied by the product's advance rate on market livestock;
4. the stated receivables value multiplied by the product's advance rate on receivables;
5. the stated prepaid inputs value multiplied by the product's advance rate on prepaid inputs;
6. the stated insured growing crops value multiplied by the product's advance rate on insured growing crops when the member holds a Crop Insurance policy in active status for the line's crop year whose indemnity is assigned to the association for this line at a coverage level of at least the product's minimum coverage level, and nothing for that class when the member holds no such policy.

Each rate is read as a percentage. The six amounts are added together and the total is rounded once to cents.

All six values come from the same certificate: the line's certificate with the latest as-of date. The advance rates and the minimum coverage level are the product's published figures.

## Worked worksheet (hypothetical Borrowing Base Operating Line certificate)

The member holds an active Crop Insurance policy for the line's crop year, indemnity assigned to the association for this line, at 75% coverage, above the product's 65% minimum.

| Class | Stated value (USD) | Product advance rate | Amount (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Unpriced stored grain | 412,345.67 | 75% | 309,259.2525 |
| Contracted grain | 200,000.00 | 85% | 170,000.00 |
| Market livestock | 100,000.00 | 75% | 75,000.00 |
| Receivables | 50,000.00 | 80% | 40,000.00 |
| Prepaid inputs | 60,000.00 | 70% | 42,000.00 |
| Insured growing crops | 300,000.00 | 65% | 195,000.00 |
| **Total, rounded once to cents** | | | **831,259.25** |

Had the member held no such Crop Insurance policy, the growing crop line would contribute nothing and the borrowing base would be USD 636,259.25.
